title: Chords
description: An interactive MicroSim demonstrating chords in circles - line segments with both endpoints on the circle's circumference.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Mathematics
Geometry
Circles
learningObjectives: Identify a chord as a line segment whose two endpoints both lie on a circle's circumference
Distinguish the diameter as the longest possible chord, the one passing through the circle's center
Compare chord lengths as the endpoints are dragged to different positions on the circle
Explain how a chord's length decreases as its distance from the circle's center increases
